scope: Installed form direction transfer on two briefs, both failing the frozen first-view gate.
contract:
# Installed first-view transfer

The prototype moved the first phone input up 219 CSS px. The trial changes the core grouped-fieldsets layout instructions. Test whether an unhinted agent reproduces the opening task hierarchy using the design context. The record must keep the same selection ID, tool schema, token limits, and other directions. Each implementation chooses typography and a focal detail suited to the brief.

Freeze form-maintenance and form-garden. Use independent shell-disabled Terra low builder threads, identical generation instructions, and equivalent installed runtimes at the exact parent and trial Git pins. Keep all rendered bytes including any failure. On both cases, require the first answer control and sufficient task context above CSS y=330 at 390 and 320 px, no overflow, and an explicit visual distinction between required and optional answers when the brief specifies both. The maintenance brief requires a clear preparation outcome and preserving first-error focus and entered values. The garden brief requires both shift times, an optional note, and exact selected-shift confirmation. Empty submission must yield actionable recovery. Confirm the keyboard journey and original screenshots before dispatching the blind panel.

This is a single experimental direction change. Keep the package isolated until the ordinary-form holdout passes and an independent comparison shows a benefit on the implemented outputs. Retain the pinned release and exact package CI as the acceptance baseline.
